The corpus is the evidence that a rename is safe, and it is written in the surface being renamed — so the thing that validates the change is the thing the change invalidates. Every certification result is produced by migrating first and checking second, which means a migration bug and a language bug are distinguishable only by a rewriter nobody has reviewed.
